_note: Dictation built from the word banks in reading-part-words.json. Each word carries the span of the lesson inside it, so a wrong spelling can be told apart from a wrong lesson. Sentences are the hand-written ones where they exist and the pattern's own passage otherwise. Built by scripts/build-spelling.mjs, checked by scripts/check-spelling.mjs.
_omitted: The fake words are not here: they are a reading task, and there is no defensible way to mark a dictated nonsense word. Nothing here says a word is irregular, because that cannot be read off a spelling.
